summary: No relevant testing skill found. Focused Iter 48 verification: real parsers now read /tmp/infocliente.xlsx as 28,620 clients and /tmp/evolucao.xlsx as 579 clients/6 periods; API uploads persist enrichment/evolution and silent-zero guard rejects malformed >10-row files. UI /finance/imports no longer shows 0/0 for newly imported real files (saw 28620/0 and 579/0), and the client credit-evolution card renders with chart and metrics. However, /api/finance/imports strips the new totals counters (clients_updated, clients_found, rows_processed, documents_created), so the frontend cannot actually show clients_updated as required and the specified regression command fails 27/30 without PYTHONPATH due ModuleNotFoundError.

critical.issue: FinanceImportResponse.totals uses ImportTotals with only clients/documents/total_* fields, so FastAPI response serialization drops rows_processed, clients_found, clients_matched, clients_updated, clients_ignored, documents_created and periods. DB has these counters, and upload response has them, but list endpoint loses them; FinanceImports therefore falls back to totals.clients instead of clients_updated.

Requested command `pytest tests/test_iteration_43... tests/test_iteration_48_infoclientes_evolucao.py` fails 27/30 as run from /app/backend: the 3 pure parser tests in iteration_48 raise ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'modules'. With PYTHONPATH=/app/backend, iteration_48 alone passes 7/7.

integration_issues.issue: UI rows show non-zero clients after import, but not from clients_updated as required because the list API omits clients_updated/documents_created. Example: InfoClientes row displayed 28620 clients instead of the 1 matched/updated client in the test seed.

action_items: Extend ImportTotals (or make FinanceImportResponse.totals a Dict[str, Any]) so GET /api/finance/imports preserves clients_updated, clients_found, rows_processed, clients_matched, clients_ignored, documents_created and periods.
Add/adjust regression test to assert GET /api/finance/imports returns the new counters, not only the immediate upload response/DB document.
Fix test import path for tests/test_iteration_48_infoclientes_evolucao.py so the exact requested pytest command passes without requiring external PYTHONPATH.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/modules/finance/models.py ImportTotals is the remaining bug source for list counters: unknown totals keys are filtered from FinanceImportResponse.
frontend FinanceImports.js has the intended fallback logic, but it cannot work for clients_updated/documents_created until the backend list response exposes those keys.
seed_data_creation: Seeded temporary finance_clients records for genes_code 2111102130 to verify InfoClientes enrichment and the credit-evolution card; cleaned the final UI seed. Upload/import history test records remain as audit records/files from test uploads.

Also re-run exact requested regression command without PYTHONPATH.
rca_of_the_issue: Original 0-client root cause appears fixed by adding Conta fallback and silent-zero guard. Remaining not_fixed verdict is due API response-model filtering of the new counters from import history, plus regression command failure.
